package.name: robot_control_pkg
package.description: Main PC decision logic and mock Doosan M0609 collaborative robot control for the reagent quality inspection system. The mock motion/gripper nodes are written to mirror the real DSR_ROBOT2 API (movej/movel/posx, RG gripper) used in this team's other Doosan bootcamp packages, so they can be swapped for real calls later.
